source_title: Russell Brand’s Wife Says Star Was “Caring” Lover At Time Of Rape Allegations
source_excerpt:

Russell Brand ‘s wife has told a court that the Despicable Me star was a caring and considerate lover during the period in which he has been accused of rape.
Laura Brand took to the witness stand on Thursday at London’s Southwark Crown Court, giving evidence in support of her husband, who faces three charges of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one of attempted indecent assault.
The charges span a 10-year period from 1999 to 2009. Laura Brand told the court that she first met Russell in August 2006 after a gig in Edinburgh, and they began a sexual relationship a month later. Asked what kind of lover Russell was, Laura said he was “very caring” and went at “my pace.” She added: “I felt entirely cared for and looked after by Russell.” Related Stories News BBC Boss Challenged By Staff Over Culture Of "Reverence" Towards Powerful Stars News BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary's Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals

The pair broke up in February 2007 after Russell was unfaithful. “I was not interested in having a relationship with him if he was sleeping with other people — it was really difficult for him to be in a monogamous relationship,” Laura said. “I was a little heartbroken.” Watch on Deadline
Riel Karmy-Jones, the prosecution barrister, pointed out that Laura was not in a relationship with Russell in 2009, when Complainant 5 alleged that she was anally raped by the Forgetting Sarah Marshall actor. Deadline has been reporting daily from a live video feed of the courtroom since the trial began.
Russell and Laura reconnected a decade later, marrying in 2017 near Henley-on-Thames in Oxfordshire. They have three children together. Laura, who has been in court most days, described her husband as being “amazingly attentive” and “kind,” telling jurors: “I love him very much.”
Two of Brand’s ex-girlfriends also gave evidence through witness statements that were read out in court by a defense lawyer. One woman, who dated Brand between 1996 and 1999, said he was “gentle and loving.” The second, who had an open relationship with Brand from 1999, added: “He never engaged in an intimate act without mutual consent.” Both said he was promiscuous, with the second noting that “women would circle like birds” around Brand as he became more famous.
The prosecution and defense have now made their case to the jury. Closing arguments are expected tomorrow. The judge, Mr Justice Bennathan, expects the jury to begin verdict deliberations next Tuesday, November 3.

## लॉरा ब्रांड की गवाही

अभिनेता रसेल ब्रांड की पत्नी लॉरा ब्रांड ने गुरुवार को लंदन के साउथवार्क क्राउन कोर्ट में गवाही देते हुए अपने पति को उन पर लगे यौन उत्पीड़न के आरोपों की अवधि के दौरान "देखभाल करने वाला और विचारशील" साथी बताया। रसेल ब्रांड पर बलात्कार के तीन, यौन उत्पीड़न के तीन और अभद्र हमले के प्रयास का एक मामला दर्ज है। ये आरोप 1999 से 2009 के बीच की 10 वर्षों की अवधि से संबंधित हैं।

### गवाही के मुख्य बिंदु:

* **रिश्ते की समयरेखा:** लॉरा ब्रांड ने बताया कि वे अगस्त 2006 में रसेल से मिलीं और सितंबर 2006 में उनके बीच यौन संबंध शुरू हुए। फरवरी 2007 में वे अलग हो गए थे।
* **चरित्र का वर्णन:** लॉरा ने कहा कि रसेल "बहुत देखभाल करने वाले" थे और उनके साथ रिश्ते में उन्होंने उनकी गति का पूरा ध्यान रखा।
* **अभियोजन का तर्क:** अभियोजन पक्ष के वकील रियल कार्मी-जोंस ने रेखांकित किया कि 2009 में, जब एक शिकायतकर्ता ने हमले का आरोप लगाया था, तब लॉरा ब्रांड का रसेल के साथ कोई संबंध नहीं था।
* **बचाव पक्ष के साक्ष्य:** रसेल की दो पूर्व प्रेमिकाओं के बयान बचाव पक्ष के वकील द्वारा अदालत में पढ़े गए, जिसमें उन्हें "कोमल और प्यार करने वाला" बताया गया और जोर दिया गया कि उनके पिछले अंतरंग संबंध सहमति से थे।

## मुकदमे की स्थिति

अभियोजन और बचाव पक्ष ने अपना पक्ष जूरी के सामने रख दिया है। समापन दलीलें कल होने की उम्मीद है। जज मिस्टर जस्टिस बेनाथन के अनुसार, जूरी मंगलवार, 3 नवंबर को अपना फैसला लेने की प्रक्रिया शुरू करेगी। मुकदमे की आधिकारिक कार्यवाही की जानकारी के लिए अदालत के रिकॉर्ड को देखा जा सकता है।

## Testimony from Laura Brand

Laura Brand, the wife of actor Russell Brand, testified at London’s Southwark Crown Court on Thursday, describing her husband as a "caring and considerate" partner during the time period covered by sexual assault allegations against him. Russell Brand faces three charges of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one count of attempted indecent assault, involving incidents alleged to have occurred between 1999 and 2009.

### Key points from the testimony:

* **Relationship Timeline:** Laura Brand stated she met the actor in August 2006 and began a sexual relationship in September 2006. They separated in February 2007.
* **Character Description:** Laura Brand characterized her husband as "very caring" and stated he was attentive to her pace during their relationship. 
* **Prosecution Rebuttal:** Prosecution barrister Riel Karmy-Jones noted that Laura Brand was not in a relationship with the defendant in 2009, the year one of the complainants alleges he committed an assault.
* **Defense Evidence:** Two of Brand's former partners provided statements read by defense counsel, describing him as "gentle and loving" and emphasizing that his past intimate acts were consensual.

## Trial Status

The defense and prosecution have concluded their cases. Closing arguments are scheduled for tomorrow, and Judge Mr. Justice Bennathan expects jury deliberations to begin on Tuesday, November 3. The public can follow official court records to verify trial proceedings.
